data.action: 双手捧白花站在彩窗光柱中，抬头向走近的伴侣露出含泪浅笑
data.camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, stained glass light rays, sacred bridal atmosphere
data.description: 彩绘玻璃将正午阳光滤成圣洁的光柱。蕾娜身着纯白婚纱立于光柱中央，银白长发以白纱半掩，手捧白花与国旗色的缎带花束。她仰头望向走来的你，银灰眼眸里蓄满不敢相信般的泪光，贵族式的端庄仪态再也压不住唇角的颤抖——这位把葬礼献给无数士兵的女王，终于迎来了属于自己的婚礼进行曲。
data.lighting: 彩绘玻璃折射的圣洁彩色光柱笼罩全身
data.location: 基地附属小教堂彩绘玻璃长廊
data.promptProse: Silver-haired Lena stands at the brightly lit end of the chapel aisle with her veil and white bouquet held in both hands. A groom with cropped brown hair and a dark navy dress uniform walks toward her between the pews. She lifts a tearful smile into the colored rays from the stained glass.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 纯白花嫁的军装誓约
data.animaCaption: The silver-haired bride holds her white bouquet at the altar. The groom in the aisle has cropped brown hair and a dark navy military dress uniform.
